    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)

    def fill_gaps(coords):
        for (r1, c1), (r2, c2) in zip(coords, coords[1:]):
            dr, dc = (r2 - r1) // max(1, abs(r2 - r1)), (c2 - c1) // max(1, abs(c2 - c1))
            steps = max(abs(r2 - r1), abs(c2 - c1))
            for k in range(1, steps):
                r, c = r1 + dr * k, c1 + dc * k
                if grid[r][c] == bg:
